verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents preserving metadata through a conversion or stripping it on request. The closest items are adjacent: color-profile processing (imagemagick-docs-7), describing image attributes (imagemagick-gh-11), and caching metadata (imagemagick-gh-24). None of these shows metadata carried through a conversion or a strip option, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, file metadata is preserved through a conversion or strippable on request
